objective: Define the smallest status/readiness hardening needed for the non-executing native-parser adapter-payload to sidecar plan-resolution fixture, so unsupported or not-ready sidecar_stage_plan results cannot be mistaken for ready direct-Verilator plan-resolution evidence before any sidecar handoff contract, command synthesis, execution, timing, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, or upstream landing claim.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted plan-resolution fixture currently sets the outer result status to planned even when the nested sidecar_stage_plan status is unsupported_for_stage_plan or planned_not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim. A caller that only checks the outer status can therefore misread a fallback or unsupported workflow as ready native Verilator plan-resolution evidence.
definition_decision.operator_goal: A future implementation may harden the existing helper in place by deriving its outer status and readiness summary from sidecar_stage_plan, while still remaining non-executing and avoiding sidecar handoff contract, command synthesis, runtime/ABI, timing, and allocation work.

planned.meaning: Template sidecar stage plan has the minimum wrapper inputs for a Verilator option shim, but is still not execution, correctness, timing, upstream support, or production evidence.

unsupported_for_stage_plan.meaning: The target or mode has no supported sidecar stage-plan boundary and must not be treated as planned native Verilator sidecar evidence.

planned_not_ready_for_verilator_option_s.meaning: A fallback or higher-level workflow can be described, but the outer status must classify direct Verilator option handoff as not ready.

required_readiness_summary.outer_status_rule: status is a direct Verilator option readiness classification: ready_for_verilator_option_shim, not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim, or unsupported_for_stage_plan
required_readiness_summary.ready_condition: ready_for_direct_verilator_option is true only when outer status is ready_for_verilator_option_shim, stage_plan.status is planned, and stage_plan.verilator_option_readiness.status is ready_for_verilator_option_shim
required_readiness_summary.not_ready_condition: unsupported_for_stage_plan and planned_not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim must set ready_for_direct_verilator_option to false and preserve the stage_plan reason or missing readiness fields
non_claims: readiness is not execution evidence
readiness is not coverage-output equivalence evidence
readiness is not timing or speedup evidence
readiness is not arbitrary RTL or filelist support
readiness is not automatic optimal GPU allocation

required_tests_for_next_implementation: template mode reports outer status ready_for_verilator_option_shim only when the nested stage_plan status is planned and readiness is ready
unsupported mode mirrors unsupported_for_stage_plan at the outer status
resident-state-reuse reports outer status not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim while preserving stage_plan_status planned_not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim
persistent-resident-state-abi reports outer status not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim while preserving stage_plan_status planned_not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim
not-ready cases preserve sidecar_stage_plan reason or missing readiness details
correctness_policy_ref remains reference-only and not compare evidence

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_status_hardening_gate
must_decide: whether readiness-classifying the outer status while preserving sidecar_stage_plan.status is the correct minimum contract
whether readiness is defined narrowly enough to prevent not-ready modes from being mistaken for direct Verilator option evidence
whether the next implementation may harden only the existing importable helper and tests
whether sidecar_handoff_contract, command synthesis, execution, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary RTL/filelist, and automatic allocation remain out of scope
must_not_claim: command synthesis from native parser payload
coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow

not a sidecar_handoff_contract boundary
